groups.script:
Woman: Hi, Marcus. The color printer on the third floor is jamming again. I've got forty brochures to print for this afternoon's client visit.
Man: Not again. The technician came on Monday, but it seems the problem wasn't fixed.
Woman: Is there another printer that can handle glossy paper?
Man: The one in the design department can. Let me call Priya over there and ask if you can use it for an hour.
Woman: That would be great. And could you contact the repair company too?
Man: Sure, I'll ask them to send someone back tomorrow morning.

questions.prompt: What problem does the woman mention?
choices: A printer is not working properly.
A client visit has been canceled.
She has run out of paper.
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ nói máy in màu ở tầng ba lại bị kẹt giấy ("is jamming again"), tức là máy in không hoạt động bình thường.

questions.prompt: What does the man say about the technician?
choices: He works in the design department.
He visited earlier in the week.
questions.explain: Người đàn ông nói kỹ thuật viên đã đến vào thứ Hai ("came on Monday"), tức là đã ghé từ đầu tuần.

questions.prompt: What will the man probably do next?
choices: Call a colleague in another department
Move the printer to another floor
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói "Let me call Priya over there" — gọi cho đồng nghiệp ở phòng thiết kế để mượn máy in.

groups.script:
Man: Hello, this is Daniel Ortiz. I booked a table for six at seven o'clock this Friday, but I need to make a change.
Woman: Of course, Mr. Ortiz. What would you like to change?
Man: Two more colleagues are joining us, so we'll be eight people. Is that possible?
Woman: Let me check... Our main room is full at seven, but we have a private room upstairs available at seven thirty.
Man: Seven thirty works. Is there an extra charge for the private room?
Woman: Not for groups of eight or more. I'll update your booking now and send you a confirmation by text message.

questions.prompt: Why is the man calling?
questions.explain: Anh ấy đã đặt bàn cho sáu người và nói "I need to make a change" vì thêm hai đồng nghiệp — tức là gọi để thay đổi đặt chỗ.

questions.prompt: What does the woman offer?
questions.explain: Phòng chính đã kín lúc bảy giờ nên cô ấy đề nghị phòng riêng trên lầu ("a private room upstairs") lúc bảy giờ rưỡi.

questions.prompt: What will the woman send the man?
questions.explain: Cô ấy nói sẽ gửi xác nhận bằng tin nhắn ("send you a confirmation by text message").

groups.context:
Riverside Business Center — Meeting Room Rates (per half day)
Oak Room (up to 6 people): $90
Maple Room (up to 12 people): $150
Cedar Room (up to 20 people): $220
Pine Hall (up to 40 people): $380
groups.script:
Woman: Good morning, Riverside Business Center. How can I help you?
Man: Hi, I'm organizing a training session for our sales staff next Thursday morning. I'd like to rent one of your meeting rooms.
Woman: Certainly. How many people will be attending?
Man: We were expecting ten, but our regional manager just told me that five more people from the Leeds office will join us.
Woman: In that case, you'll need a larger room than you planned. Will you need a projector?
Man: Yes, and could you also arrange coffee for the group? We'll have a break at around ten thirty.
Woman: No problem. I'll email you a booking form with our catering options.

questions.prompt: What is the man planning?
questions.explain: Người đàn ông nói đang tổ chức buổi đào tạo cho nhân viên kinh doanh ("a training session for our sales staff").

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. Which room will the man most likely rent?
questions.explain: Dự kiến 10 người nhưng thêm 5 người nữa, tổng 15 người; theo bảng, phòng nhỏ nhất chứa được 15 người là Cedar Room (tối đa 20).

questions.prompt: What does the man ask for?
questions.explain: Anh ấy nhờ chuẩn bị cà phê cho cả nhóm vào giờ nghỉ khoảng 10 giờ 30 — tức là đồ uống cho giờ giải lao.

groups.script:
Man 1: Sandra, Kevin, thanks for joining. I've just heard from the factory in Busan. The packaging for our new blender won't be ready until the twentieth.
Woman: The twentieth? Our launch event is on the eighteenth. The invitations have already gone out to retailers.
Man 2: We could still hold the event and show prototypes. Retailers mostly want to see the product working anyway.
Woman: That's true. We'd just need to tell them shipping will start a week later.
Man 1: OK. Kevin, can you prepare a few demonstration units?
Man 2: Sure. I'll get the lab team to set aside five of them today.

questions.prompt: What problem are the speakers discussing?
questions.explain: Nhà máy báo bao bì máy xay sinh tố mới phải đến ngày 20 mới xong, trễ hơn sự kiện ra mắt ngày 18.

questions.prompt: What does Kevin suggest?
questions.explain: Kevin (Man 2) đề xuất vẫn tổ chức sự kiện và trưng bày mẫu thử ("show prototypes").

questions.prompt: What will Kevin do today?
choices: Have some demonstration units set aside
questions.explain: Kevin nói sẽ nhờ nhóm phòng thí nghiệm để riêng năm máy trình diễn ngay hôm nay ("set aside five of them today").

groups.script:
Woman: Hello, I live in apartment 4B on Linden Street. The heating in my bedroom stopped working last night.
Man: I'm sorry to hear that. Is the heating in the other rooms working?
Woman: Yes, it's just the bedroom. The radiator is completely cold.
Man: It might just be air in the system. Our maintenance worker, Tom, can take a look. Will you be home tomorrow between nine and noon?
Woman: Unfortunately, I work in the mornings. Could he come after four?
Man: Let me see... Yes, he can come at four thirty. I'll put you on his schedule.

questions.prompt: Where does the man most likely work?
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ là cư dân căn hộ gọi báo hỏng sưởi, và anh ấy cử nhân viên bảo trì của mình ("Our maintenance worker") — nên anh làm ở văn phòng quản lý tòa nhà.

questions.prompt: What does the woman say about the heating?
choices: It is not working in one room.
It is too expensive to run.
questions.explain: Cô ấy nói sưởi chỉ hỏng ở phòng ngủ ("it's just the bedroom"), các phòng khác vẫn chạy.

questions.prompt: Why does the woman request a later time?
choices: She is waiting for a delivery.
questions.explain: Cô ấy nói "I work in the mornings" nên không ở nhà từ 9 giờ đến trưa, vì vậy xin hẹn sau 4 giờ.

groups.context:
Departures — Trains to Hartford
Train 412 — 9:05 — Platform 2
Train 518 — 9:40 — Platform 5
Train 220 — 10:15 — Platform 3
Train 634 — 10:50 — Platform 1
groups.script:
Man: Excuse me, I was supposed to take the nine-oh-five to Hartford, but the board says it's been canceled.
Woman: Yes, I'm sorry. There's a signal problem further up the line. Your ticket is valid on any later train today.
Man: I have a meeting in Hartford at eleven thirty, and the trip takes about an hour. Which train should I take?
Woman: The next one is still on time, so you'll be fine with that. Just be aware it's leaving from a different platform than usual.
Man: Thanks. Do I have time to grab a coffee first?
Woman: Yes, there's a café right by the stairs, but don't take too long.

questions.prompt: Why was the man's train canceled?
questions.explain: Nhân viên nói có sự cố tín hiệu phía trước tuyến ("a signal problem further up the line").

questions.prompt: What does the woman say about the man's ticket?
choices: It must be exchanged at the counter.
It can be used on a later train.
It is valid only in first class.
questions.explain: Cô ấy nói vé vẫn dùng được cho bất kỳ chuyến muộn hơn trong ngày ("valid on any later train today").

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. Which platform will the man most likely go to?
questions.explain: Chuyến 9:05 bị hủy, nhân viên khuyên đi chuyến kế tiếp, theo bảng là chuyến 518 lúc 9:40 ở sân ga 5.

groups.script:
Woman: Ahmed, I've gone over the new proposal from Castellan Logistics. Their rates are about eight percent lower than what we pay now.
Man: That's a significant saving. What's the catch?
Woman: They want a three-year commitment, and their delivery window is forty-eight hours rather than twenty-four.
Man: Hmm. Our customers in the hospitality sector count on next-day delivery. Losing that could cost us more than we'd save.
Woman: Agreed. But I'm wondering whether we could use them just for our non-urgent bulk orders and keep our current carrier for the rest.
Man: That's worth exploring. Why don't you ask Castellan whether they'd accept a smaller contract on those terms?

questions.prompt: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
choices: A proposal from a logistics company
questions.explain: Cả cuộc hội thoại xoay quanh đề xuất mới của công ty vận chuyển Castellan Logistics (giá, thời hạn hợp đồng, thời gian giao hàng).

questions.prompt: What does the man imply when he says, "What's the catch?"
choices: He suspects the offer has drawbacks.
He thinks the rates are too high.
He has not read the proposal.
He wants to sign the contract immediately.
questions.explain: "What's the catch?" nghĩa là "vướng mắc ở đâu?" — anh ấy nghi đề nghị rẻ như vậy có điểm bất lợi; người phụ nữ liền nêu các điều kiện kèm theo.

questions.prompt: What will the woman most likely do next?
choices: End the contract with the current carrier
Ask the supplier about a limited contract
questions.explain: Người đàn ông bảo cô hỏi Castellan xem họ có nhận hợp đồng nhỏ hơn với các điều kiện đó không ("a smaller contract on those terms").

groups.script:
Man: Lucia, have you tried the new sandwich shop across from the bank?
Woman: Not yet. Is it any good?
Man: It's great, and they have a lunch special: a sandwich, soup, and a drink for nine dollars.
Woman: That sounds like a good deal. Do they deliver? I have a lot of work today.
Man: They do, but only for orders over twenty dollars. Why don't we order together? I'll get something for Ben too.
Woman: Good idea. I'll have the chicken sandwich with tomato soup.

questions.prompt: What are the speakers discussing?
questions.explain: Người đàn ông hỏi Lucia đã thử tiệm bánh mì kẹp mới đối diện ngân hàng chưa, và họ bàn về tiệm này.

questions.prompt: How much does the lunch special cost?
questions.explain: Suất trưa gồm bánh mì, súp và đồ uống giá chín đô ("for nine dollars"); 20 đô là mức tối thiểu để giao hàng.

questions.prompt: Why does the man suggest ordering together?
choices: To save time waiting in line
To reach the minimum for delivery
questions.explain: Tiệm chỉ giao cho đơn trên 20 đô, nên anh ấy rủ đặt chung (và đặt thêm cho Ben) để đủ mức giao hàng.
